paper_main_claim: Single-hierarchy classification fails for entities with multiple roles
paper_method: Two orthogonal structures: paradigmatic (is-a) tree and assignment (role) tree
paper_key_result: Separates identity from role, resolving contradictions like teacher/son (George)
paper_application: CIMWorld: assignment-tree ontology for an automated factory (RPI, 1980s)
paper_change_types: Paradigmatic transition (form changes, identity stays) vs ontological transition (structure changes)
student_takeaway: Benzon's problem not solved by LLMs, only sidestepped via statistical pattern matching, not explicit structure
